notes.title: Update 12/7/23
notes.content:
[b][GAMEPLAY][/b]
Update AI behavior.
AI can shoot StunGun.
All players see the location of the frag leader

[b][MAPS][/b]
The glitch in Colossus map
Mines can pass through the hexagonal panels in fractal.


[b][UI][/b]
A broken layout is presented in case ping is an integer
Display the user's name and Steam icons
Design for inputs block in settings
Highlight the settings icon in case the user is on the settings screen;
UI improvements;
Restrict possibility of joining other sessions while connection to the session is in progress;
Implement host disconnected feature;
Settings look fuzzy in case the user enters the session and then goes to settings
Implement solutions for case when the session is full of players 

[b][ANIMATION][/b]
Empty textures from which you can see and shoot everything, but you can't be seen from it by others

[b][MISC][/b]
In case a high ping connection to the session is too long
Fix the ESC hotkey after pressing it while on the Settings menu
The 'Help' option in the pause menu fails to function
issues with inputs
Issue with keyboard

[b][Team Deatchmatch][/b]
The mouse disappears on team selection, can't select teams.
Unable to use the game mouse/hover after switching the laptop window
In case a high ping cursor disappears
Fix cursor issue 
Team deathmatch stats
